definitions.full: H7502. raphad [ רָפַד ] verb spread (Assyrian rapâdu , stretch oneself ; Arabic prop up, support, aid, give , compare Pi`el below; Sabean רפדת plural protection, guard , CIS iv, no. 40, 3 , compare ארפד terraces DHM Hofmus .); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular יִרְמַּד Job 41:22 he (the crocodile) spreadeth a threshing-sledge upon the mud (leaves marks upon it from his scales). Pi`el Perfect 1south of couch (figurative) יְצוּעָ֑י רִמַּדְתּי Job 17:13 ; then ( spread out any support, hence) Imperative masculine plural suffix רַמְּדוּנִי Song 2:5 support me with apples (|| סַמְּכוּ ).
